actions.name: createGraphics
actions.summary: Creates a validated backend-neutral graphical object or collection at an explicit position in the graphic hierarchy.
useWhen: Use this extension primitive inside a domain action when a validated graphical subtree must be attached at one explicit hierarchy position.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action when an existing owned resource should be revised, or when required inputs leave multiple compatible sources unnamed.
requiredState: An extension-authored domain action must provide a validated semantic or graphical target path and preserve ChartProgram immutability.

parameterNotes.description: Assigns a stable resource identifier so later actions can target this exact owner without relying on inference.
Chooses the supported resource, scale, coordinate, graphic, transform, or selector type for this action.
Names the graphical parent collection that receives a newly created extension-authored object.
Places a new graphical object immediately before this existing sibling inside the same parent.
Places a new graphical object immediately after this existing sibling inside the same parent.

graphic: Creates a validated backend-neutral graphical object or collection at an explicit position in the graphic hierarchy.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.

commonErrors.problem: Leaving multiple compatible datasets, marks, scales, coordinates, or owners unnamed causes an ambiguity error instead of first-item selection.
commonErrors.fix: Pass the exact public identifier required by the signature, or create the missing prerequisite before calling this action.

actions.name: editGraphics
actions.summary: Edits one validated graphical property or removes one named graphic subtree through the public extension primitive.
useWhen: Use this extension primitive inside a domain action when one validated graphical property or complete top-level subtree must change.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action before the owned resource exists or when more than one compatible target remains unnamed; create or target it explicitly first.
requiredState: The exact existing owned resource must be present and uniquely inferable, or the action must receive its explicit target identifier.

parameterNotes.description: Names the exact existing resource to change when current state does not identify one unique compatible target.
Provides the constant value assigned by this action instead of a field-driven mapping.
Names the validated semantic or graphical property path affected by this extension primitive.

graphic: Edits one validated graphical property or removes one named graphic subtree through the public extension primitive.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.

commonErrors.problem: Calling the action without an existing unique owner causes a missing-target or ambiguous-target error.
commonErrors.fix: Pass the exact public identifier required by the signature, or create the missing prerequisite before calling this action.

avoidWhen: Avoid this action before the owned resource exists or when more than one compatible target remains unnamed; create or target it explicitly first.
requiredState: The exact existing owned resource must be present and uniquely inferable, or the action must receive its explicit target identifier.

parameterNotes.description: Provides the constant value assigned by this action instead of a field-driven mapping.
Names the validated semantic or graphical property path affected by this extension primitive.

semantic: Creates, replaces, or removes one supported semantic property path for extension-authored domain actions.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.

commonErrors.problem: Calling the action without an existing unique owner causes a missing-target or ambiguous-target error.
commonErrors.fix: Pass the exact public identifier required by the signature, or create the missing prerequisite before calling this action.
